headline: Public hearings on tax abatement requests from six property owners, including requests for hardship relief and refunds.
summary: Six property owners are asking for tax relief, including help with 2026 taxes, back taxes, and late fees. One owner seeks a refund for taxes paid on a demolished structure.
items: Delia Properties LLC, 131 Main Street, Unit C-1: hardship help for about 30% of 2026 taxes due
Fisk, 52 Loaldo Drive: abatement of multiple years of back taxes due to medical problems, requested before a city tax sale
Hajrovic, 58 Valade Road: abatement of late fee and penalty for taxes paid late
Leclair & 120 Hyde Street LLC: hardship abatement for properties at 54 Spruce Street, 29-33 South Willard Street, and 120 Hyde Street
Workman, 120 Lori Lane: refund for taxes paid on a structure demolished before he bought the property
234 SNA LLC, 131 Church Street: abatement of penalties and interest from 2025 and 2026, blamed on an error by its property management company
location: Sharon Bushor Room, Ground Flr., City Hall

Meeting Tuesday, November 17, 2026 – Tax Abatement Committee Hearing Agenda –

Category 3. Conduct Abatement Hearing – hearing petitioners in order of arrival.  
 
Petitioners DELIA PROPERTIES LLC, 131 MAIN STREET, Unit C-1, PID# 049-3-095-005: 
Petitioner requests hardship assistance for approximately 30% of the 2026 
taxes due.
FISK, 52 LOALDO DRIVE, PID# 028-1-010-000: Petitioner requests multiple 
years of back taxes be abated due to medical problems. This requests comes 
on the cusp of impending tax sale by the city.  
 
 HAJROVIC, 58 VALADE ROAD, PIC# 024-1-078-058: Petitioner requests 
abatement of late fee and penalty amount applied when his taxes were paid 
late. 
 
 LECLAIR & 120 HYDE STREET LLC, 54 SPRUCE STREET, PID# 049-4-082-000 and 
29-33 SOUTH WILLARD STREET, PID# 045-2-252-000 and 120 HYDE STREET, 
PID# 040-2-041-000: Petitioner requests abatement due to hardship – owner 
of record has died and the properties are not producing enough income to pay 
for themselves.  
 
 WORKMAN, 120 LORI LANE, PID# 025-1-039-000: Petitioner requests refund 
for taxes paid on a structure that was demolished before the purchase of 
property by himself. However, current owner did not confirm record during 
grievance hearings in previous years nor alert office of assessor that property 
record was inconsistent with what was purchased.  
 
234 SNA LLC, 131 CHURCH STREET, PID# 049-3-115-000: Petitioner requests 
abatement of penalties and interest and other that arose in 2025 and 2026 
due to an administrative breakdown originating with the professional 
property management company that 234 SNA LLC had retained to handle the 
property’s administration
